posts.title: Why are people so scared of causing fear?
posts.description: An odd aspect of discussing serious threats is the amount of concern people express about you causing other people to be concerned. This kind of makes sense for interlocutors who don’t believe in the threat itself, or think it is overblown (though in that case it is perhaps strange to focus on altruistic concern for potential frightened onlookers rather than the object-level disagreement). posts.title: Numb mental state shifts
posts.description: There are different mental states that feel different. Those are relatively obvious. For instance, being angry or drunk or frustrated or besotted. Then—for me at least—there are different mental states that don’t immediately feel like anything, but where in acting I notice that my behavior is different, or different things feel easy or impossible.
